claim_type: Measured execution/accounting; semantic failures are explicit unblinded builder judgments, not an independent oracle.
production_path: vocabulary::apply then postproc::refine (production prompt, request serialization, response normalization, usage and shared deadline)

accounting.counter_policy: Read before and after every serial call; budget against max(counter high-water, initial usage plus all known provider charges). Reserve byte-bounded input plus 256 framing tokens and 1024 completion tokens at capped prices with a 10% margin. A backwards read never refunds room. Unknown liability halts; no paid retries.
accounting.credential_placement: Native pass-env process only; reverse-forwarded loopback HTTP carries no authorization header from the worker.

interrupted_attempt.recovery: Byte-identical production request hashes replay retained completed responses locally; no duplicate upstream submission.

upstream_latency_ms.scope: 41 original unique cloud submissions; local replays excluded

semantic_reviewer: ElevateMode.ElevateEval (builder-agent, unblinded; semantic review of every synthetic source/output pair)
limitations: One sequential sample per case; no paid retries or paid judge. This light gate is not a reliability estimate or native UI/dictation proof.
Semantic judgments are explicit builder-agent review, not an independent blinded judge. Clean accepted strings are never scored.
The native broker adds only disclosed test-only generation/price bounds; system/user/model/reasoning remain the production request.
